label: PID tuning
info:
Advisory PID tuner.

MQTT telemetry -> digest (GET /pid + sample ring) -> LLM proposal -> deterministic validator (envelope, step caps, rate limit) -> human Apply/Reject -> POST /pid.

cfg.dryRun = true in the CONFIG node means nothing is ever written to the device; every action is logged instead. Flip it to false only once you trust the proposals.

label: Build digest
tooltip: Fetch GET /pid, digest the last 10 min, ask the model

label: Apply proposal
tooltip: Re-read GET /pid, then POST the validated subset (no-op while dryRun)

label: Revert to last good
tooltip: POST the parameters captured just before the last apply
